title: Adaptive Early-Learning Correction for Segmentation from Noisy Annotations (ADELE)
mechanism: Detects per class the onset of memorisation from the train IoU curve against noisy labels, then from that point replaces labels with confident, multi-scale-consistent model predictions.
adaptation: Per-class curves for crack, inactive, gridline and splice on the 478 train cells. Correction is allowed only (a) within 3 px of an existing crack label, to re-centre it on the ridge while keeping that source's width, and (b) for new components with p>0.9 at every scale, to recover missing cracks. Padding, frame and structural classes are never corrected. Flips and rot90 only as consistency views (label-safe).
min_experiment: Arm: PF + ADELE on crack and inactive, 5 seeds, 20k steps. Baseline: PF, 5 seeds. Metrics: relF1@2 and relR@2 at relP@2>=0.90, components >=20 px found, crack IoU, inactive IoU on test-clean-49 and E1. Kill if relF1@2 gain <0.01 and component-recall gain <0.02, or if crack IoU drops by more than 0.012.
evidence: R (abstract): beats standard noisy-label methods on a medical segmentation task with noisy annotations, and is SOTA for weakly supervised segmentation on PASCAL VOC 2012. Thin-structure numbers were not read because the full text was unavailable.
prior_overlap: none. BRIEF section 5 lists noisy-label methods and automatic label refinement as never tried.

alt_notes.adaptation: Separate triggers for crack, inactive, gridline, splice, edge_dark; corrections allowed only within 2 px of existing crack labels (no new components) to protect recall.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + ADELE, 3 seeds on 5-fold CV. Baseline: house folds. Metric: fold-mean crack IoU, mIoU_rob. Promote only if gain >= +0.01. About 15 GPU-h.

alt_notes.adaptation: Log per-class train IoU curves over the 20k steps; apply correction to crack only within 2 px of the original label, and to gridline, splice, edge_dark, material where labels look incomplete. Keep inactive uncorrected (well labelled).
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + ADELE correction, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metric: clean-49 crack IoU, gridline IoU, mIoU_rob. Kill: crack IoU and mIoU_rob both within noise (under 0.012 and under 0.01).
